description: Abstract class defining interval-based aggregation logic with timezone and offset handling, including interval start/end calculations and validation.

classes.name: BaseAggInterval
classes.description: Abstract class for interval-based aggregation with timezone and offset management, providing methods for interval start/end calculations and validation.

methods.name: getZoneId
methods.description: Returns the ZoneId object based on the timezone string.

methods.name: getOffsetSafe
methods.description: Returns the offset in seconds, defaulting to 0 if null.

methods.name: getCurrentIntervalDurationMillis
methods.description: Calculates the duration of the current interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: getCurrentIntervalStartTs
methods.description: Gets the start timestamp of the current interval.

methods.name: getDateTimeIntervalStartTs
methods.description: Calculates the start timestamp for a given ZonedDateTime.

methods.name: getCurrentIntervalEndTs
methods.description: Gets the end timestamp of the current interval.

methods.name: getDateTimeIntervalEndTs
methods.description: Calculates the end timestamp for a given ZonedDateTime.

methods.name: alignToIntervalStart
methods.description: Abstract method to align a ZonedDateTime to the start of an interval.

methods.name: getAlignedBoundary
methods.description: Returns the aligned boundary for a reference ZonedDateTime, either the next or current interval start.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates timezone and offset parameters, throws exceptions if invalid.
